verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לֵאמֹר֒ כִּֽי־ נֶ֗פֶשׁ תֶחֱטָ֤א בִשְׁגָגָה֙ מִכֹּל֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִצְוֺ֣ת תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְעָשָׂ֕ה מֵאַחַ֖ת לֹ֣א מֵהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rå̄·ʾēl lê·mōr kî- ne·p̄eš ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh mik·kōl Yah·weh ’ă·šer miṣ·wōṯ ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh wə·‘ā·śāh mê·’a·ḥaṯ lō mê·hên·nāh
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites . . . to do as follows with one who sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s - commandments and does . . . what is forbidden by them

verses.original: אִ֣ם הַמָּשִׁ֛יחַ הַכֹּהֵ֧ן יֶחֱטָ֖א לְאַשְׁמַ֣ת הָעָ֑ם וְהִקְרִ֡יב לַיהוָ֖ה פַּ֣ר תָּמִ֛ים בֶּן־ בָּקָ֥ר עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃ חָטָ֜א
verses.transliteration: ’im ham·mā·šî·aḥ hak·kō·hên ye·ḥĕ·ṭā lə·’aš·maṯ hā·‘ām wə·hiq·rîḇ Yah·weh par tā·mîm ben- bā·qār ‘al ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ḥā·ṭā
verses.literal: If the anointed priest sins bringing guilt on the people he must bring to the LORD a young bull without blemish . . . . . . as a sin offering - for the sin he has committed

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת־ הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ הַפָּ֔ר רֹ֣אשׁ וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- hap·pār ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·sā·maḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al- hap·pār rōš wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hap·pār lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: He must bring - the bull to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD lay - his hand on the bull’s head and slaughter - it before the LORD

verses.original: הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ הַכֹּהֵ֥ן וְלָקַ֛ח הַפָּ֑ר מִדַּ֣ם וְהֵבִ֥יא אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mā·šî·aḥ hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ hap·pār mid·dam wə·hê·ḇî ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ וְטָבַ֧ל אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ בַּדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־ הַדָּ֜ם שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- wə·ṭā·ḇal ’eṣ·bā·‘ōw bad·dām wə·hiz·zāh min- had·dām še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’eṯ- pə·nê pā·rō·ḵeṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The priest - is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD . . . in front of the veil of the sanctuary

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֨ן וְנָתַן֩ מִן־ הַדָּ֜ם עַל־ קַ֠רְנוֹת מִזְבַּ֨ח הַסַּמִּים֙ קְטֹ֤רֶת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת׀ יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ כָּל־ הַפָּ֗ר דַּ֣ם אֶל־ יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯan min- had·dām ‘al- qar·nō·wṯ miz·baḥ has·sam·mîm qə·ṭō·reṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’êṯ yiš·pōḵ kāl- hap·pār dam ’el- yə·sō·wḏ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The priest must then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD - in the Tent of Meeting And he is to pour out the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering - at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יָרִ֣ים כָּל־ חֵ֛לֶב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה עַל־ הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yā·rîm kāl- ḥê·leḇ mim·men·nū ’eṯ- par ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ha·ḥê·leḇ ham·ḵas·seh ‘al- haq·qe·reḇ wə·’êṯ kāl- ha·ḥê·leḇ ’ă·šer ‘al- haq·qe·reḇ
verses.literal: Then he shall remove all the fat from - the bull of the sin offering the fat that covers the entrails - all the fat that is on [them]

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃ עַל־ הַכְּלָי֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·tê hak·kə·lā·yōṯ wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ’ă·šer ‘ă·lê·hen ’ă·šer ‘al- hak·kə·sā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hay·yō·ṯe·reṯ ‘al- hak·kā·ḇêḏ yə·sî·ren·nāh ‘al- hak·kə·lā·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: - both kidneys - with the fat - on them - near the loins and the lobe of the liver which he is to remove with the kidneys

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יוּרַ֔ם מִשּׁ֖וֹר זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִקְטִירָם֙ עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yū·ram miš·šō·wr ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm hak·kō·hên wə·hiq·ṭî·rām ‘al miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: just as the fat is removed from the ox vvv of the peace offering Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering

verses.original: וְאֶת־ ע֤וֹר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֔וֹ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַל־ כְּרָעָ֑יו וְקִרְבּ֖וֹ וּפִרְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·wr hap·pār wə·’eṯ- kāl- bə·śā·rōw ‘al- rō·šōw wə·‘al- kə·rā·‘āw wə·qir·bōw ū·p̄ir·šōw
verses.literal: - But the hide of the bull - and all its flesh with its head . . . and legs and its entrails and dung

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֠פָּר וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ מִח֨וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה אֶל־ טָהוֹר֙ אֶל־ מָק֤וֹם אֶל־ הַדֶּ֔שֶׁן שֶׁ֣פֶךְ וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ עֵצִ֖ים בָּאֵ֑שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃פ עַל־ הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן שֶׁ֥פֶךְ
verses.transliteration: kāl- hap·pār wə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh ’el- ṭā·hō·wr ’el- mā·qō·wm ’el- had·de·šen še·p̄eḵ wə·śā·rap̄ ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ‘ê·ṣîm bā·’êš yiś·śā·rêp̄ ‘al- had·de·šen še·p̄eḵ
verses.literal: all the rest of the bull he must take - outside the camp to a ceremonially clean . . . place where the ashes are poured out and there he must burn - it on a wood fire - on the ash heap

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִשְׁגּ֔וּ דָּבָ֔ר וְנֶעְלַ֣ם מֵעֵינֵ֖י הַקָּהָ֑ל וְ֠עָשׂוּ אַחַ֨ת מִכָּל־ יְהוָ֛ה מִצְוֺ֧ת וְאָשֵֽׁמוּ׃ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה
verses.transliteration: wə·’im kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl yiš·gū dā·ḇār wə·ne‘·lam mê·‘ê·nê haq·qā·hāl wə·‘ā·śū ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kāl Yah·weh miṣ·wōṯ wə·’ā·šê·mū ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh
verses.literal: Now if the whole congregation of Israel strays unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly so that they violate any . . . of the LORD’s commandments and incur guilt by doing what is forbidden . . .

verses.original: וְנֽוֹדְעָה֙ הַֽחַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטְא֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ הַקָּהָ֜ל פַּ֤ר וְהִקְרִ֨יבוּ בֶּן־ בָּקָר֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·wḏ·‘āh ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū ‘ā·le·hā haq·qā·hāl par wə·hiq·rî·ḇū ben- bā·qār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hê·ḇî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: when they become aware of the sin - they have committed . . . then the assembly . . . must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: זִקְנֵ֨י הָעֵדָ֧ה אֶת־ וְ֠סָמְכוּ יְדֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־ הַפָּ֖ר רֹ֥אשׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַפָּ֖ר וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ziq·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’eṯ- wə·sā·mə·ḵū yə·ḏê·hem ‘al- hap·pār rōš lip̄·nê Yah·weh hap·pār wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The elders of the congregation - are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD and it shall be slaughtered - before the LORD

verses.original: הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ הַכֹּהֵ֥ן וְהֵבִ֛יא הַפָּ֑ר מִדַּ֣ם אֶל־ אֹ֖הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mā·šî·aḥ hak·kō·hên wə·hê·ḇî hap·pār mid·dam ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the bull’s blood into the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְטָבַ֧ל אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ מִן־ הַדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֞ה שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·ṭā·ḇal ’eṣ·bā·‘ōw min- had·dām wə·hiz·zāh še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’êṯ pə·nê hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: and [he] is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD . . . in front of the veil

verses.original: יִתֵּ֣ן׀ וּמִן־ הַדָּ֞ם עַל־ קַרְנֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ כָּל־ הַדָּ֗ם אֶל־ יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: yit·tên ū·min- had·dām ‘al- qar·nōṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’êṯ yiš·pōḵ kāl- had·dām ’el- yə·sō·wḏ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: He is also to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD - in the Tent of Meeting and he must pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering - at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת יָרִ֣ים כָּל־ חֶלְבּ֖וֹ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ yā·rîm kāl- ḥel·bōw mim·men·nū wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh
verses.literal: And he is to remove all the fat from it and burn [it] on the altar

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֣ה לַפָּ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְפַ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֔את יַעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֑וֹ כֵּ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְכִפֶּ֧ר עֲלֵהֶ֛ם וְנִסְלַ֥ח לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh lap·pār ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·p̄ar ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ya·‘ă·śeh- lōw kên hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ă·lê·hem wə·nis·laḥ lā·hem
verses.literal: He shall offer this bull just as he did the bull for the sin offering - in this way the priest will make atonement on their behalf and they will be forgiven . . .

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׂרַ֣ף אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂרַ֔ף אֵ֖ת הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן הַפָּ֣ר הֽוּא׃פ חַטַּ֥את הַקָּהָ֖ל
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- hap·pār ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·śā·rap̄ ’ō·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer śā·rap̄ ’êṯ hā·ri·šō·wn hap·pār hū ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ haq·qā·hāl
verses.literal: Then he is to take - the bull vvv outside the camp and burn it just as he burned - the first bull It is the sin offering for the assembly

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשִׂ֖יא יֶֽחֱטָ֑א בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה וְעָשָׂ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ אַחַ֣ת מִכָּל־ מִצְוֺת֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֜יו תֵעָשֶׂ֛ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer nā·śî ye·ḥĕ·ṭā biš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·‘ā·śāh ’ă·šer lō- ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kāl miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh wə·’ā·šêm
verses.literal: When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the commandments of the LORD his God . . . he incurs guilt

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ הוֹדַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ חַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְהֵבִ֧יא אֶת־ תָּמִֽים׃ שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים זָכָ֥ר קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- hō·w·ḏa‘ ’ê·lāw ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā bāh wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- tā·mîm śə·‘îr ‘iz·zîm zā·ḵār qā·rə·bā·nōw
verses.literal: - When he becomes aware . . . of the sin - he has committed he must bring - an unblemished male goat . . . . . . as his offering

verses.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ הָעֹלָ֖ה יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הֽוּא׃ חַטָּ֖את
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ yā·ḏōw ‘al- rōš haś·śā·‘îr wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯōw bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer- hā·‘ō·lāh yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- lip̄·nê Yah·weh hū ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: He is to lay his hand on the head of the goat and slaughter - it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered - before the LORD It is a sin offering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלָקַ֨ח מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ דָּמ֣וֹ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ mid·dam ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nōṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- yiš·pōḵ dā·mōw ’el- yə·sō·wḏ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar -

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יַקְטִ֣יר כָּל־ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה כְּחֵ֖לֶב זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yaq·ṭîr kāl- ḥel·bōw ham·miz·bê·ḥāh kə·ḥê·leḇ ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: - He must burn all its fat on the altar like the fat vvv of the peace offerings thus the priest will make atonement for that man’s sin and he will be forgiven

verses.original: וְאִם־ נֶ֧פֶשׁ אַחַ֛ת הָאָ֑רֶץ מֵעַ֣ם תֶּחֱטָ֥א בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה בַּ֠עֲשֹׂתָהּ אַחַ֨ת יְהוָ֛ה מִמִּצְוֺ֧ת וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ne·p̄eš ’a·ḥaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ mê·‘am te·ḥĕ·ṭā ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh ba·‘ă·śō·ṯāh ’a·ḥaṯ Yah·weh mim·miṣ·wōṯ wə·’ā·šêm
verses.literal: And if one . . . of the common people sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited . . . - by any of the LORD’s commandments he incurs guilt

verses.original: א֚וֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אֵלָ֔יו חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְהֵבִ֨יא תְּמִימָ֣ה נְקֵבָ֔ה שְׂעִירַ֤ת עִזִּים֙ קָרְבָּנ֜וֹ עַל־ חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw hō·w·ḏa‘ ’ê·lāw ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā wə·hê·ḇî tə·mî·māh nə·qê·ḇāh śə·‘î·raṯ ‘iz·zîm qā·rə·bā·nōw ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā
verses.literal: - When he becomes aware . . . of the sin he has committed he must bring an unblemished female goat . . . as his offering for that sin . . . . . .

verses.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַט֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֖וֹם הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al rōš ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bim·qō·wm hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: He is to lay - his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter - it at the place of the burnt offering

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֤ן וְלָקַ֨ח מִדָּמָהּ֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ כָּל־ דָּמָ֣הּ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ mid·dā·māh bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nōṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- yiš·pōḵ kāl- dā·māh ’el- yə·sō·wḏ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take some of its blood with his finger put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יָסִ֗יר כָּל־ חֶלְבָּ֣הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵלֶב֮ הוּסַ֣ר מֵעַ֣ל זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְהִקְטִ֤יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה נִיחֹ֖חַ לְרֵ֥יחַ לַיהוָ֑ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yā·sîr kāl- ḥel·bāh ka·’ă·šer ḥê·leḇ hū·sar mê·‘al ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm hak·kō·hên wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh nî·ḥō·aḥ lə·rê·aḥ Yah·weh hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: Then he is to remove all the fat just as [it] is removed from vvv the peace offering and the priest is to burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD In this way the priest will make atonement for him and he will be forgiven

verses.original: וְאִם־ יָבִ֥יא כֶּ֛בֶשׂ קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לְחַטָּ֑את יְבִיאֶֽנָּה׃ תְמִימָ֖ה נְקֵבָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yā·ḇî ke·ḇeś qā·rə·bā·nōw lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ yə·ḇî·’en·nāh ṯə·mî·māh nə·qê·ḇāh
verses.literal: If, however he brings a lamb - as a sin offering he must bring an unblemished female

verses.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַ֤ט אֹתָהּ֙ לְחַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָעֹלָֽה׃ יִשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al rōš ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯāh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer hā·‘ō·lāh yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ-
verses.literal: And he is to lay - his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered -

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלָקַ֨ח מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ כָּל־ דָּמָ֣הּ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ mid·dam ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nōṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- yiš·pōḵ kāl- dā·māh ’el- yə·sō·wḏ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יָסִ֗יר כָּל־ חֶלְבָּ֣ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר חֵֽלֶב־ הַכֶּשֶׂב֮ יוּסַ֥ר מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֹתָם֙ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו עַל־ חַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ חָטָ֖א וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yā·sîr kāl- ḥel·bāh ka·’ă·šer ḥê·leḇ- hak·ke·śeḇ yū·sar miz·ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯām wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘al ’iš·šê Yah·weh hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ḥā·ṭā wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: And he shall remove all the fat just as the fat of the lamb is removed vvv from the peace offerings and [he] - shall burn it on the altar along with the food offerings to the LORD In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin - he has committed and he will be forgiven
